entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to make a return for a helmet I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Ray, and the order number is VF886109.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order for the Aero-Vent helmet, delivered on January 1st. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The online color just looks different in person, and it doesn't match my bike's frame. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched the helmet itself.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've confirmed it. Because the helmet is a standard item, it falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that window, I can approve this return for a full refund right now. We want to ensure you're happy with your gear and its safety features.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I am sending it back, and the box is unopened, is there any way you could provide a small credit or a discount code for my next purchase? I'm going to order a different color right away.

I'm glad I could process the return for you. While I can't offer an additional discount for a preference-based return, I can assure you the return itself is free of charge. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email on file. Once we receive the helmet, your full refund will be processed.
Alright, I thought I'd ask. A pre-paid label works. Thanks for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
